_what: the wall-clock sensitivity of the dry harness, isolated on one arm. A proof pass that ran 9 dry cells at once disagreed with a committed digest on exactly one of them, and this file is the probe that says why.
_caching_register: DRY cells: no engine, no server, no prefix cache, and no model latency is measured anywhere here. The sensitivity is to HOST WALL CLOCK inside the decision path.
_design: two hypotheses for the disagreement, separated by one pair of cells. H1 the proof's own wrappers on `_deficit_order_key` and `decide`. H2 host load. Both cells below run the SAME arm on the SAME cell at loadavg about 2; the first keeps the wrappers, the second has none. If H1 held, the first would still disagree.

C_instrumented_at_concurrency_9._note: the first proof pass. The other EIGHT cells of that pass reproduced their expected digests, both positive controls included, so arm-versus-arm checking could not have seen this.

verdict.evidence: A and B agree with each other AND with the committed value (9a4be873eb3c5fba / 14218 and 9a4be873eb3c5fba / 14218), so removing the wrappers changes nothing and reducing load fixes it. Wall time per cell fell from about 600 s to 218.4 s.
verdict.why_this_arm: the C5 attribution rule is the one mechanism in this set gated on a latency EWMA. Bare and quiet it is UNEXERCISED in dry: _attr_mon empty at end of run, cap still 8, and no c5_attr counter exists at all, which is what c5attr_digest_proofs.json P3 recorded. Under load the cap moved.
verdict.named_defect: the reproduce-across-runs defect named at 3325e02c, now with a measured trigger: concurrency. Patching cf_instrument.over_budget off does not cover it.
verdict.consequence: a dry digest from this harness is a property of the arm AND of how busy the host was. d184_r3_c5attr_proofs.json therefore runs bare at declared concurrency 4 and carries a self-reproduction control on its comparator.

_provenance._git_commit_register: the commit the MEASUREMENT RAN ON: the code tree is `git archive <this ref> experiments`, not origin/main at writing time
